text_block_list.name: Espo & Furioso
text_block_list.text: ORAAGHHH!! DAAAAGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—Hey. Furioso.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(When I saw you training with your buddies 
in Funabashi... to tell ya the truth, it 
scared the crap outta me.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Their running got seriously better, so I 
guess "that" really was the right way 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Frustrated, bitter, resentful...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...Hating myself for thinking 'that must 
be nice'...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Still, right now—)

text_block_list.name: Espo & Furioso
text_block_list.text: ORAAGHHH!! DAAAAGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What a clash of spirits...! Will the 
victor be Furioso-san!? Or—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's watch closely now. Rickey-chan, 
...Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The weapons belonging to those oni at the 
top of the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna forge our own iron clubs too. 
Just like them... Our very own special 
weapons, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *phew*â

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Furioso!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I was "strong," wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You were strong in your own way, too. 
Accomplishing things that I never could."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Still, there really was a path ahead this 
way too, y'know!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wobbly, pitch black. Even on a path that 
would normally make you want to turn 
back...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's still a way forward—and I'm gonna 
take it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"You really are just putting on a brave 
face. Many times more... stubborn than I 
am."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Still, because it is you... perhaps you 
will walk that path straight and true to 
the end."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yet I, too, take pride in having been able 
to choose my own path.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
When the day comes for our paths to cross 
again... let us battle once more. Both of 
us—stronger than we are today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, let's run together again, 
Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Furioso! Well done! You truly are the 
star of Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City! Go take the dirt throne for 
yourself!
(WOOOOOOAAAAAHHH――)

...Amazing. Chants like an earthquake...! 
Everyone's passion all at once—

Ugh, I can't hold back anymore! I want 
to—with you—☆

It happened after the Winning Live 
concluded. Espoir City was held back by 
the reporters remaining at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Which GⅠ will you enter for your next 
race? Is there any chance of fitting in 
another race before autumn!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are you also considering an overseas 
campaign? When are you planning to 
schedule some rest?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Back off! Shut up! Hey, Trainer, 
handle this—...
—Next time, catch me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
On a starlit night, flashing a sparkling 
smile☆ Everyone's Umadol, Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Falco?

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Wait, Falco!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"No way!? Why is the Sand Falcon on her 
winning streak right here—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I came to see you, Espo-san! So I can 
become a sparkling dirt Umadol!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Espo-san. Falco's gotten super-duper 
stronger than last year too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go on a nationwide tour, become an Umadol 
who can go meet her fans in person, and 
slowly take over the trending topics.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can sing "UNLIMITED IMPACT" flawlessly 
now, too.

"UNLIMITED IMPACT." That was the song from 
the Dirt GⅠ Winning Live that Espoir City 
had just performed earlier.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—And today, I saw new potential in both 
you and me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With Espo-san by my side, we can repaint 
our stage and take it to a whole new 
level.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because any stage with you— is bound to 
get everyone super excited.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So come to the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Wasn't Falco in the middle of 
her "Number One Everywhere Declaration", 
winning every race she enters?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be insanely hype if that 
really happened? With this matchup, no 
matter who wins...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah... Falco.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You've got that look on your face like 
you're already carryin' the whole burden 
on your shoulders, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because we can shoulder it—the future of 
dirt racing. As our generation's glorious 
debut unit, that is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me. I always figured you were 
someone I'd have to beat into the dirt 
sooner or later."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... getting involved 
with you was the "spark" that started it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Because the strength you showed me was 
different from mine.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Because you had that look on your face, 
completely convinced that admitting your 
weakness was the right answer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna crush you, Falco.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna shove it right in your face that 
my way was the right one all along.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaan☆ I'm getting dizzy~...! Falco might 
still need a lot more training~?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Tch... Unshakable as always, damn it.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Yet despite that, there's not a single 
opening on her. The reason for that is――)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because I have shortcomings, I work hard. 
If I overcome them— Falco will get one 
step closer to perfection, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—! Good grief... You really piss me off, 
you bastard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe☆ ...So, what do you think? About our 
collab, that is.

Smart Falcon is undeniably strong. Yet 
it's precisely because she's so 
formidable—that I want to see the moment 
Espoir City triumphs.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Fine by me, Trainer.

The sand falcon that was once a fledgling 
and Espoir City make a vow. The showdown 
will take place at the Teio Sho in June.
